peak_descriptor: Strict rise followed by non-rise on the unchanged 1 m reference; no prominence filter. Diagnostic only.
shape_decision: Review reduction in landmark alignment and shared-scale variety; no automated aesthetic gate or outcome-dependent retuning.
authoritative_surface: Resolved 4 m piecewise-linear polyline, with only explicitly recorded fixed local pad patches for scenarios.

pad_preparation.surface_height_rule: Original resolved-polyline height at each pad centre; no vertical normalization.
pad_preparation.transition_rule: Linear shelf-edge to original-polyline outer anchor; retain original vertices and insert exact patch/shelf boundaries. Outside patches identical.

scenario_template.provenance: Exact v2_clear_845 scenario from capture-session-repair-20261005-native; only used for supported vehicle, gravity, clocks and route-free mission defaults.

native_validation: pd-cli waypoint-v2-flight --preflight-only; never pass output-dir or create a simulator.
